Subject: ARR certification workshop + evidence needed

Hi Jonas/Marissa,

Thanks for the time on Friday — Nimbus Health is beginning our internal certification for vendor ARR ahead of our board packet and we need to align on a small set of deliverables from Redwood to validate bookings and committed ARR for Q2. High level ask: can you provide a reconciled bookings export, a short one-page narrative of any notable ARR variance, and evidence for any deals marked as "commit" in your CRM?

What we need from your side by EOD Wednesday (4/7):
- CSV export of committed bookings by close date (pipeline stage, ARR, ACV)
- One-page summary of forecast movement compared to last month (drivers + risks)
- Evidence bundle (signed SOWs, PO confirmations, internal approval emails) for deals > $150k ARR

Attaching our template for ARR recon to make it easier. Let us know if any of the deal IDs in the template need clarification.

Cheers,
Sarah Collins
Head of RevOps, Nimbus Health

Sarah — thanks and understood. We'll drive to the Wednesday EOD deadline. Proposed plan:

1) Internal commit sweep (Mon-Tue): Marissa & Vanessa will update CRM stages and reconcile bookings exported from HubSpot.
2) Evidence collation (Tue): Vanessa will package signed SOWs / PO notes into an evidence zip.
3) Narrative + variance one-pager (Tue night): I will draft, Vivek will sanity-check unit economics.
4) Delivery (Wed morning): we'll drop the exports + evidence + one-pager into the Drive folder you shared and confirm on this thread.

Marissa/Vanessa — can you run the pipeline export against close date window 2027-01-01 -> 2027-04-03 and make sure stage values follow our ARR definitions ("Commit" = Legal-signed or PO received)? Flag any deals where there's ambiguity.

Vivek — quick ask: I flagged deal NIM-2027-0423 as a potential variance (notes below). Can you confirm whether to include it in committed ARR for the board?

Thanks all — we'll be concise on the one-pager and call out only top-line drivers and any reopen items.

— Jonas
